label: Salesforce
description: Work with Salesforce CRM records: create leads, contacts, opportunities, and tasks, and query or manage any object.
notes: Auth: AP uses OAuth2 with a per-connection instance URL; mapped to SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN plus SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL since every REST call is rooted at the org's instance URL. createRecord/updateRecord pass config.data through as the ENTIRE request body (required field, nothing embedded around it) because Salesforce requires a true JSON object of fields and templates cannot build one from string configs; this is a whole-body passthrough, not a value embedded inside a JSON literal. Optional text fields (FirstName, Email, Phone, Title, Description, LeadSource) are kept in bodies because the Salesforce REST API treats an empty string as null for text and picklist fields. Optional lookup-ID fields (AccountId, ContactId, WhoId, WhatId, RelatedToId) were DROPPED because an empty string is not a valid Salesforce ID and would be rejected; use createRecord/updateRecord with explicit data for those. createOpportunity drops the optional numeric Amount field (API requires a JSON number; include it via createRecord instead). Dynamic dropdowns (object, record, owner, stage, picklists) became text fields with help hints. AP's 'other_fields' extra-JSON props were dropped from the fixed-field nodes; the generic createRecord covers arbitrary fields. update-contact/update-lead were not transpiled: their optional fields sent as empty strings would destructively null out existing values, and salesforce.updateRecord covers them safely. find-record and find-records-by-query build quoted SOQL from user values (quote-escaping not expressible in templates); salesforce.runSoqlQuery covers them. delete-opportunity is covered by deleteRecord. Transpilable but skipped due to the 8-node cap: create-note, create-case, add-contact-to-campaign, add-lead-to-campaign, find-child-records, send-email. needsPieceRuntime: add-file-to-record (file upload, base64), create-attachment (file upload, base64), export-report (binary download + file write, multi-request), get-record-attachments (two queries merged), run-report (heavy response transformation), upsert-by-external-id (requires typed JSON boolean allOrNone and records array), upsert-by-external-id-bulk (multi-request Bulk API job orchestration with CSV upload). Triggers (not transpiled): new-case-attachment, new-contact, new-field-history-event, new-lead, new-updated-record, new-outbound-message, new-record, new-updated-file, new-case-in-queue.
